verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for an inference platform, so the axis applies. However, every cited deployment option still runs on DeepInfra's own cloud: dedicated instances with private endpoints, and rented GPU clusters with SSH access. Nothing shows the core DeepInfra product being deployed on user-owned infrastructure, so these options are adjacent managed hosting, not self-hosting.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
